summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Savariya Overseas marketing site via the preview URL (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080/1920x800, tablet 768x1024, mobile 390x844). Verified all 7 routes + 404, desktop & mobile navigation, mobile sticky action bar, Home sections (6 service cards, animated stats, 5-step process timeline, 5 industry cards, CTA), Services jump chips + hash deep-linking from service cards, footer links, and the full contact form flow (validation, arithmetic spam check, mailto happy path, success panel, reset). No console/page errors on any route, no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint, no broken images. Backend testing skipped per request.

issues: Footnote label 'Savariya Overseas — Rajkot/Ahmedabad' uses color rgb(148,163,184) at 11px on white (~2.7:1 contrast) - fails WCAG AA for small text; darken to slate-500/600

action_items: LOW: Fix 3 ESLint react/no-unescaped-entities errors (apostrophes) in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx:93, /app/frontend/src/pages/About.jsx:47, /app/frontend/src/components/CTASection.jsx:22.
LOW: ContactForm spam question is memoised with an empty dependency list, so clicking 'Submit another inquiry' (contact-form-reset-btn) keeps the SAME arithmetic question. Regenerate it on reset.
LOW: Increase contrast of the 11px office footnote labels on the Contact page.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactForm.jsx: validate() only checks the email regex - a filled-but-invalid email and a missing email produce the same message; acceptable, but consider distinguishing 'required' vs 'invalid'.
Reveal.jsx did not forward extra props, which prevented data-testid on wrapped elements (process timeline steps). Fixed by spreading ...rest; keep this pattern for future testids.

ScrollManager relies on the target element existing in the same commit as the route change; it works today for /services#<slug>, but if Services is ever lazy-loaded the hash scroll will silently fall back to scroll-to-top.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios passed (3 low-priority polish findings)

seed_data_creation: None - static site, no backend. Contact form submitted with TEST_ prefixed data (mailto only, nothing persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: all routes render h1 with zero console errors; nav-link-* and nav-request-quote-btn navigate correctly; mobile drawer opens (height 482px) and collapses to 0 after navigation; sticky-call-btn tel:+917990496099, sticky-email-btn mailto:savariyaoverseas@gmail.com, sticky-quote-btn -> /contact; stats counters animate to '10+' and '2'; process-timeline now exposes data-testid process-step-1..5 (added by me via Reveal prop forwarding); all 6 services-jump-<slug> chips land the section at y=96 (below the 74px fixed header) and every service-cta-<slug> -> /contact; service-learn-more-<slug> deep-links to /services#<slug> and scrolls correctly; contact form shows all 5 required errors on empty submit, keeps focus while typing (no re-mount), success panel appears after valid submit and reset restores a cleared form; footer has 7 nav links, 6 footer-service-<slug>, correct tel/mailto. No horizontal scroll at 1920x800, 768x1024, 390x844 on /, /services, /contact.
rca_of_the_issue: Process timeline steps had no per-step data-testid because Reveal.jsx dropped unknown props. Fixed in test-scope by spreading ...rest onto the framer-motion element and adding data-testid={`process-step-${s.step}`} in ProcessTimeline.jsx; verified 5 steps detected on both / and /how-we-work.
